title: ESI contribution rates
description: The employer's and the employee's contributions to the Employees' State Insurance Corporation for a wage period under Chapter IV of the Code on Social Security, 2020, as rule 19(1) of the Social Security (Central) Rules, 2026 sets them from 8 May 2026: each a share of the wages payable to the employee, “rounded to the next higher rupee”, which the set writes as rounded up to a multiple of ₹1. The set starts on 8 May 2026: ESIC's consolidated text of rule 51 of the Employees' State Insurance (Central) Rules, 1950, which governed before, still prints the rates its footnotes say G.S.R. 423(E) replaced from 1 July 2019, so the rates of 1 April to 7 May 2026 are not seeded. The shares not paid for some employees are the set esi.contribution-exemptions. Contributions fall due on the last day of the wage period (section 29(4) of the Code), and the set answers for that day.

columns.name: roundedUpTo
columns.title: Rounded up to a multiple of (₹)

instruments: Social Security (Central) Rules, 2026, G.S.R. 344(E), 8 May 2026, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (i), No. 310, 8 May 2026, rule 19(1); rule 1(2): “They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette.”

cells.name: Employer's contribution
cells.wording: 19. Rate of contributions.—(1) The amount of contribution for a wage period shall be in respect of— (a) employer's contribution, a sum (rounded to the next higher rupee) equal to three and one-fourth per cent. of the wages payable to an employee; and

cells.name: Employee's contribution
cells.wording: 19. Rate of contributions.—(1) The amount of contribution for a wage period shall be in respect of— (b) employee's contribution, a sum (rounded to the next higher rupee) equal to three-fourth per cent. of the wages payable to an employee.
